Teacher help

Right now
The buttons

Next ▶ The page never moves by itself. Press Next only when the children are ready.

🔁 Again Says the line again. Use it as often as you like.

◀ Back Goes back one page.

📖 Pages Jump to any page. ⏭ Last page goes straight to goodbye.

⚪ circles The circles at the top jump to each part of the lesson.

Keyboard: Space is Next, R is Again, the arrow keys go back and forward, P opens Pages, Home and End go to the first and last page, 1 to 6 jump to each part, F is full screen.
